name: Ragnar Lothbrok
subtitle: Sire of Heroes
description: Fight alongside Lagertha and cripple your foes Defence and Resolve with fearsome strikes.
lore: Related to Sigurd via marriage to Aslaug, and father of many heroes with many wives, Ragnar is known foremost for his relations but was a powerful warrior and king in his own right. A kind leader to his soldiers but viciously cruel to enemies, he conducts raids on Asgard’s neighbors, determined to become best known for his own glory—regardless of consequences.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%
Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%

skills.name: Warlord of Midgard
skills.description: Place 15%HP on this hero when their HP falls below 50%.

skills.name: Frenzied Slash
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (4%HP+50%ATK)3 times. Each hit has a 15% chance to place [mechanic:blunt-i] on the target for 2 turns. If Lagertha is on the team, also joins the attack.

skills.name: Maelstrom of Steel
skills.description: Attack all enemies (8%HP+160%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-i] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Nordic Onslaught
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (6%HP+90%ATK)2 times. Each hit destroys the target’s Max HP for 5% of the damage inflicted (up to 25% of the target’s Max HP).
skills.awakening_bonus: If this hero’s HP is below 50%, also heals for 20% of the damage inflicted.

imprint_passive: Place 15%HP on this hero when their HP falls below 25%.
